directory.s1: Create your business listing on {domain}, or claim the existing one.

content.s3: Link it from your site’s menu so it’s easy to find.

prices_as_images.s3: Update the text whenever prices change.

no_business_markup.s1: Add LocalBusiness markup to your site’s code: name, address, phone, opening hours, prices.
no_business_markup.s2: Check it with Google’s Rich Results Test.
no_business_markup.s3: Update the markup when your hours or address change.

contacts_missing.s1: Write your address, phone and opening hours as text at the bottom of every page.
contacts_missing.s2: Add a map and a landmark to the contact page.
contacts_missing.s3: Make sure 2GIS and other directories show the same details.

ai_bots_blocked.task: AI assistants’ crawlers are blocked from my site, so ChatGPT and the others can’t read it.
ai_bots_blocked.s1: Find what serves https://{domain}/robots.txt and allow these user agents: OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, Google-Extended, Googlebot, Bingbot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot. Remove the Disallow rules that block them (or a “Disallow: /” under “User-agent: *”); keep the rules for private pages (admin, cart, account).
ai_bots_blocked.s2: Check that no page sends these bots a meta robots tag or an X-Robots-Tag header with noindex or noai, and that the hosting or CDN (for example Cloudflare’s “Block AI bots”) doesn’t block them.
ai_bots_blocked.s3: Make sure the home page and the service and price pages answer 200 with their text in the HTML.

what.a: GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is how visible your brand is in the answers of AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini, and how to improve it. When a customer asks “Which … in Tashkent is the best?”, AI names a few places. GEO is about being one of them.

seo.q: How is this different from SEO?
seo.a: SEO is about ranking among Google’s 10 links. AI gives a ready answer with 2–3 names instead of links. To be in it, the sites and directories AI relies on need correct information about you, and your own site needs to answer the customer’s question clearly.

engines.q: Which AI assistants do you check?
engines.a: ChatGPT (OpenAI, with web search on) and Gemini (with Google Search), asked from your customer’s country: the closest we can get to the answer a customer sees. Google’s AI answers in Search and Yandex are coming soon.

accuracy.a: AI answers the same question a little differently each time. So we don’t judge by one answer but by the share over all your questions, and the trend over several weeks is more reliable than a single check. Every report states the model and the date, and you can read every answer yourself.

countries.q: Does it work for a business outside Uzbekistan?
countries.a: Yes. You choose the country, and the questions are asked as a customer there: in Uzbek and Russian in Uzbekistan; in Russian in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Russia and Belarus; in English everywhere else.

notMentioned.q: What if AI doesn’t mention me at all?
notMentioned.a: For a small or new business that’s the most common case, and it’s exactly where to start. The check shows who AI recommends instead of you and which sites it relies on. The first steps are usually getting listed on those sites and filling in the information on your own site.

free.q: Is the first check really free?
free.a: Yes. You sign in with your email, and we don’t ask for a card. The first check, its results, the report link and the list of fixes are free. Further checks come with a plan.

install.q: Do I need to install anything on my site?
install.a: No. All we need is your website address: no code, plugins or passwords.

time.q: How soon will I see results?
time.a: The first check is ready in 2–3 minutes. On a plan, a check runs every week (twice a week on Pro). Changes to your site and directory listings usually show up in AI answers within a few weeks.

share.title: Share the results
share.text: Copy a link to the report, open it to print or save as a PDF, or download the numbers as CSV.

verdict.title: Where you stand
verdict.text: One sentence on how AI talks about your business this week, next to your strongest competitor.

kpis.title: Your five numbers
kpis.text: How often AI names you, your share among the brands, your place in its lists, its tone and how often it relies on your site, each with the change since last week. ⓘ explains a number.

trend.title: Over the weeks
trend.text: Every brand at each weekly check. Switch the measure above the chart; ⤢ opens it large, with how to read it.

sources.title: The sites AI relies on
sources.text: The sites its answers cite most. Being named on them is the surest way into its answers; a site opens its own page.

topics.title: By topic and language
topics.text: Where AI names you and where it doesn't. Start with a weak topic: it opens its questions.

todo.title: What to do next

topics.title: Questions by topic
topics.text: Pick a topic to see its questions. “New topic” adds one; the pencil beside a topic opens it to rename or delete it.

tabs.title: Tracked, suggested, archived
tabs.text: Tracked questions are asked every week. Suggested ones are worth adding. Archived ones are no longer asked, but keep their answers.

add.title: Add questions
add.text: The ring shows how many questions your plan holds. Add your own, or let “Find questions” suggest them from your services.

summary.title: Your numbers on these questions
summary.text: Visibility, tone, position and web search over the questions shown. They change with the search and the filters.

row.title: One question
row.text: A click opens its page: its answers, its charts and the fixes that should move it.

footer.title: Several at once
footer.text: Tick questions to move them to a topic, archive or track them: this bar acts on the ones you picked.

filters.title: Filters
filters.text: Pick the weeks the charts show, and in “All filters” the competitors to compare with and the kinds of sites to count.

header.title: This question
header.text: Its language, its topic and whether it's asked every week. Archive it to stop asking it: its answers stay.

verdict.title: What its answers say
verdict.text: One sentence on the latest answers to this question: who AI names, and how often you're among them.

trend.title: This question over the weeks
trend.text: The overview's charts for this one question: the brands at each check and how they rank.

sources.title: Sources for this question
sources.text: The sites AI cites when it answers this question. Get onto the ones that name your competitors.

searches.title: What AI searched for
searches.text: The web searches behind its answers: the words your pages should answer.

todo.title: Fixes for this question
todo.text: The actions that should move it, the most useful first. Each opens in Actions.

answers.title: Its answers
answers.text: The answers of the latest check, word for word, with the brands named and the sites cited.

intro.title: How it works
intro.text: Tell us what you sell and who buys it: we write the questions such customers ask AI, with topics for them.

form.title: Two short steps
form.text: Your services and customers first, then the languages of the questions.

buttons.title: Get the questions
buttons.text: They arrive in Suggested on the questions page: track the ones you want, reject the rest.

kpis.title: The answers in numbers
kpis.text: How many answers AI gave, and how many name you, speak badly of you, name no brand at all, or searched the web first.

tools.title: Find answers
tools.text: Search their text, or filter them by brand, status and cited site. CSV downloads them with their full text.

answer.title: One answer
answer.text: Each question comes with its three answers. A click opens one like a chat, with the sites it cites.

analyze.title: Ask Seenova AI
analyze.text: Seenova AI reads these answers for you and says what stands out and what to do about it.

kpis.title: Where you stand
kpis.text: Your place among the brands, the gap to the leader, the topics you lead and the questions you're missing from.

ranking.title: The brands side by side
ranking.text: Every brand on the four measures, with the change since last week. ⤢ opens the table large.

topics.title: Who leads each topic
topics.text: The brand AI names most on each topic, and your place there. A topic opens its questions.

untracked.title: Brands you don't track yet
untracked.text: Brands AI names that aren't on your list. Track one to follow it here, or hide it.

rivals.title: Where each competitor wins
rivals.text: The questions where a competitor is named and you aren't. A question opens its page.

views.title: Sites or pages
views.text: See the sites AI cites, or their pages one by one.

presence.title: Where you're missing
presence.text: How much of what AI relies on leaves you out, and which sites to get onto first.

gaps.title: Places to get listed
gaps.text: “Gaps” keeps only the sites where competitors are named and you aren't: the first places to get onto.

site.title: One site
site.text: A click opens the site's page: how often it's cited, who's named there and how to get listed.

chart.title: The most cited
chart.text: The five sites cited most, at each weekly check.

movers.title: What changed
movers.text: Sites cited for the first time, more or less than at the last check, and whether those citations work for you.

header.title: This site
header.text: What kind of site it is, how often AI cites it now and at the last check, and whose site it is.

verdict.title: What it means for you
verdict.text: Whether you're named on it, which competitors are, and the fix that gets you listed.

chart.title: Over the checks
chart.text: The site and its pages at each weekly check.

movers.title: What changed here
movers.text: Its pages cited more or less since the last check, and who AI names when it cites this site.

views.title: Pages and answers
views.text: Its pages one by one, or the answers that cite it, word for word.

summary.title: What AI says about you
summary.text: Everything the assistants said, checked against your website: how much is wrong, how much isn’t on your site, how much is right.

wrong.title: Correct the wrong first
wrong.text: What AI got wrong, and the truth. “How to fix” opens its plan in Actions, with a task for your AI.

unverified.title: Not on your website
unverified.text: What AI says that your site doesn’t: put it on your site, or add the correct fact to your facts.

confirmed.title: What’s right
confirmed.text: What AI gets right about you, as on your website.

settingsNav.title: The settings’ menu
settingsNav.text: Your project’s settings, then your account’s. “Overview” at the top takes you back to the project.

brand.title: Your brand
brand.text: Its name and website, and the spellings the answers are searched for: “Name and website” changes them.

business.title: About the business
business.text: Description, field, identity, services and customers. The suggested questions are written from them; save at the bottom.

markets.title: Target market
markets.text: The city the questions are asked from: choose it in the list or on the map.

facts.title: Your facts
facts.text: True statements about you, one a row. AI’s answers are checked against them; “Fill from the website” offers some.

found.title: From your website
found.text: What we found on the site: add the ones worth checking, then save.

brands.title: Tracked brands
brands.text: You and your competitors. ⋯ on a row edits a brand or stops tracking it; “Add a brand” adds one while the plan has room.

suggestions.title: Brand suggestions
suggestions.text: Brands AI names that you don’t track: ✓ tracks one, ✕ hides it.

tags.title: Question tags

account.title: Your account
account.text: Your name and the email you log in with.

language.title: Interface language
language.text: Uzbek, Russian or English, for the screens you see.

members.title: Members

current.title: Your plan
current.text: Your plan, its price, how it is paid and when it renews; on the right, the AI assistants it tracks.

plans.title: Every plan
plans.text: Compare the plans and ask to switch: we change it and send the payment details.

condition.title: The condition
condition.text: The overall score with its status, and the five areas it is made of, each with the fact behind its score.
